purpose: Study these before building UI. They are the anti-slop references for this library.

sites.name: Grainient
sites.use: Texture, grain, dither, and real backgrounds. Prefer these over generic glass, neon glow, or purple gradients.

sites.name: Animate UI
sites.use: Motion that has a job: hover, state change, enter/leave. Do not decorate every element.

sites.name: Transitions
sites.use: Page and view transitions. Short, directed, no bounce-as-personality.

sites.name: Bklit Area Chart
sites.use: How a real chart is composed: data, axes, tooltip, loading. Copy this discipline, not a fake SaaS card.
